{{Quote|The Force healed that? By the look of those cuts you should have gangrene from your quads to your toenails.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] to [[Bullyak]]|<ref name="Children of the Jedi (novel)">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>}}
'''Gangrene''' was a complication of cell [[Death/Legends|death]] characterized by the decay of body tissues, which became black and/or green and malodorous. It was caused by an infection, such as by bacteria or by blocked [[Blood/Legends|blood]] vessels. It was usually the result of critically insufficient blood supply. This condition was most common in the lower [[Limb/Legends|extremities]]. The best treatment for gangrene was the restoration of blood flow of the affected organ, which could reverse some of the effects and allow healing. Other treatments include removal of the dead tissue and surgical amputation.
